corpus_boundary.available_material: Frozen fleet-register rows, selected raw Story M0.6 investigations, frozen Watch/OEM audits, preserved hashes, normalized incidents, and local executable tests.
corpus_boundary.unavailable_material: Complete BANKAI lead body and denominator, full Watch Notebookcheck hit audit, common source/region manifest, common claim-search plan corpus, and raw linked provider artifacts.
corpus_boundary.handling: No missing incident, row, timestamp, denominator, source outcome, supersession state, or coverage was inferred. Derived summaries remain derived.

independence_and_counting.counting_policy: Count implementation or incident behavior, not evidence records, summaries, reports paired with their source, or CVC normalization.
shared_ancestry_controls: Story report and aggregate summary are not counted separately.
BANKAI rows and BANKAI synthesis are not counted separately.
Watch incident, handbook, and audit summary are not counted separately.
Diagnostic incident and CVC normalization are not counted separately.
independence_and_counting.material_shared_ancestry_caveat: The accessible evidence is largely normalized from the frozen fleet register and selected linked artifacts; independence is conservatively bounded where raw implementation histories are unavailable.

replay_summary.replay_limit: Selected local Story artifacts and tests replay; the minimum cross-fleet E4 benchmarks do not.

frozen_wishlist_blocker.specific_missing_evidence: A complete, replayable lead-versus-admitted-evidence benchmark including the BANKAI denominator, source scope, fetch/admissibility outcomes, and final task state.
frozen_wishlist_blocker.best_candidate_system_source: OEM Radar / BANKAI-II experimental evidence path
frozen_wishlist_blocker.why_it_matters: The frozen review proves separation mechanics but records an incomplete recall body and denominator, so admission conclusions remain bounded.
frozen_wishlist_blocker.minimum_sufficient_proof: One frozen benchmark in which every lead has fetch, admissibility, provenance, target-binding, and final-status fields and the run can be replayed without unavailable primary artifacts.

breadth.basis: Story and OEM provide materially different discovery/admission implementations; Watch and Diagnostic-linked failure evidence is carried conservatively.

independence.basis: Report/summary pairs and CVC normalizations are excluded from independent counts.

failure_success_support.basis: Category-only/non-target lead handling, incomplete BANKAI recall, wrong NBC relation, PSREF review-only isolation, and local separation tests provide both boundary successes and failure evidence.

observability.basis: Selected Story records expose lead, fetch/admission, relation, source class, stage, and task-state fields.

reproducibility.basis: Pixel and local tests replay, but the complete lead-level BANKAI benchmark and primary body are unavailable.

profile_stability.basis: The boundary appears in Story and OEM, but target-binding and admission semantics are not demonstrated by a complete cross-profile benchmark.

evidence_boundary.basis: The exact frozen BANKAI denominator/body and every-lead accounting remain missing.

rule_reviews.finding: Discovery pointers are visibly separated from evidence in selected Story/OEM paths, but the preserved S25 relation error and incomplete BANKAI benchmark prevent E4.
rule_reviews.remaining_evidence_request: The exact frozen minimum proof: a complete replayable BANKAI lead-versus-admitted-evidence benchmark with denominator, source scope, fetch/admissibility, provenance, target binding, and final task state for every lead.

frozen_wishlist_blocker.specific_missing_evidence: A complete bounded-negative research case with exact scope, query stages, budget, fetch outcomes, stopping reason, and an independent hit audit.
